rows.note: Use this when “specifically” means in particular, singling out one person or thing.

example.english: This time I want to thank many people, specifically you.
example.traditional: 今次我想多謝好多人，特別係你。
example.jyutping: gam1 ci3 ngo5 soeng2 do1 ze6 hou2 do1 jan4 dak6 bit6 hai6 nei5

rows.note: Use this with speech or writing verbs when “specifically” means explicitly or plainly.

example.english: Please specifically clarify which day it is.
example.traditional: 請你清楚咁講明係邊一日。
example.jyutping: cing2 nei5 cing1 co2 gam2 gong2 ming4 hai6 bin1 jat1 jat6

rows.note: Use this when specifically doing something carries the additional sense of doing it deliberately or on purpose.

example.english: I specifically bought the cake you like most.
example.traditional: 我特登買咗你最鍾意食嘅蛋糕。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dak6 dang1 maai5 zo2 nei5 zeoi3 zung1 ji3 sik6 ge3 daan6 gou1

rows.note: Use this when something is specifically intended, designed, or done for a particular purpose or target.

example.english: This shop specifically sells vegetarian food.
example.jyutping: ni1 gaan1 pou3 zyun1 mun4 maai6 sou3 sik6
